title: Renew a pest management technician or fumigator licence
summary: Learn how to renew a pest management technician or fumigator licence, which is regulated by the NSW Environment Protection Authority (EPA).
intro:
The NSW Environment Protection Authority (EPA) regulates the proper use of pesticides.

If you hold a current licence, you'll receive a reminder notice and a renewal form from the EPA before the expiry date.

You must apply for a new licence within 60 days of the expiry date.
who_can_apply: Must hold a current licence for a pest management technician or fumigator.
what_you_need: A current licence (to receive a reminder notice and renewal form from the EPA before expiry).
Access to eConnect EPA for online renewal or replacement card application.
Current licence fees (listed on the EPA web page Pest management technicians, fumigators and training permits).

how_to_steps.text: You can renew your licence online using eConnect EPA.
Note: If your pesticide licence identification card has been lost, damaged, destroyed or stolen, you'll need to apply for a replacement card through eConnect EPA.

fees: You'll find current licence fees listed on the EPA web page Pest management technicians, fumigators and training permits.

faqs.q: How do I renew my licence?
faqs.a: You can renew your licence online using eConnect EPA.

faqs.q: What happens if my licence expires?
faqs.a: You must apply for a new licence within 60 days of the expiry date.

faqs.q: What if my licence identification card is lost or damaged?
faqs.a: If your pesticide licence identification card has been lost, damaged, destroyed or stolen, you will need to apply for a replacement card through eConnect EPA.
